title: Current edition cover for homepage and website sharing
user_quote: The image attached to the website/home page should always be the current edition cover. Make that a rule.
rule: The homepage’s principal image and root/homepage sharing preview always use the current catalogue edition’s complete approved front cover, including masthead, Odia signature, issue/date and artwork. Featured-poem rotation is independent. The cover changes automatically on current-edition promotion. A missing/stale current cover is a build error, never a generic-artwork fallback.

implementation.metadata: Select the newest edition using the publication catalogue, matching the visible ink-current-edition cover. Read the canonical cover-layout composition; static OG/Twitter tags point to one content-hashed JPEG. Cache identity includes artwork, composition/lettering and required local cover fonts.
implementation.rendering: Rasterize the canonical front SVG with local licensed masthead/Indic fonts. Embed the original artwork as lossless PNG for SVG renderer compatibility. Preserve the full 2:3 cover on the existing 1200×630 paper sharing canvas; no new artwork or cover redesign.
implementation.preserved: Other page-specific preview mappings and all 659 other raster images remain identical. Original covers, poems, credits, font files, runtime services, consent, release gates and featured-poem rotation remain unchanged.

checklist.route: index.html and its canonical root URL; existing homepage family
checklist.source: Same current edition as the visible homepage; canonical cover-layout-b SVG and artwork.
checklist.artwork: Complete approved current front cover, no cropped-away lettering or borrowed portrait. Historical courtyard remains preserved for other established uses/history.
checklist.sharing: One matching static OG/Twitter image; edition/date alt; cache changes on promotion; repository-path and domain-root URL behavior covered.
checklist.review: Exported JPEG inspected directly and its dimensions/artwork region checked. No browser layout change, live provider submission or platform-cache test.
checklist.handoff: Final synchronization/storage check follows saved canonical records.

executor: Current chat assistant; Samanta implementation/Drishti self-review

tests.order: Full suite ran after the final completed build.
tests.new_regressions: Current full front cover wins over portraits/responsive/older images; edition promotion changes its cache key even with unchanged artwork; stale/missing visible current cover is rejected.

export.alt: Kabita Live — Issue 48, October 2026. Complete front cover.
export.publication: Local only; no push/deployment or platform cache request.

image.visual_self_review: Complete front cover directly inspected: riverbank artwork, masthead, Odia signature and issue/date present and uncropped, on paper surround. Not a live social-platform cache test.

resolved_findings: First raster candidate retained lettering but omitted the embedded WebP artwork. Replaced the SVG image data with a lossless PNG encoding of the same source before rasterizing; rebuilt and directly inspected the finished complete cover. First failed candidate retained as evidence.
An initial bare-node command resolved to the obsolete system runtime. All final build/test commands explicitly use Node 24.15.0.
limits: No public deployment or live platform sharing/cache test. A generated static sharing image is verified separately from Facebook/WhatsApp cache display.
Existing page layout is unchanged; visual self-review covered the exported sharing raster, not a new browser layout audit.
checks.publication: Local only; no push, deployment or platform-cache request.
